mentions.name: Quackwave
mentions.description: A browser-based party game platform, like Jackbox but with no host screen — players just need a web browser open on a phone, tablet, or PC. The platform and its games were developed with AI, including AI-written Playwright end-to-end tests (with test code at over 2:1 to production code) and human verification of screenshots. It has been played with friends and family while iterating.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been having a bunch of fun working on a couple games on a new platform - everything (platform and games) developed with AI.

quackwave.com

Hasn't really been stress tested yet (this is the first time I'm mentioning it publicly), but it's been fun playing with friends & family and iterating.

Party game platform, think "jackbox but no host screen" - just need a web browser open on phone/tablet/PC.
